failuresByRootCause.title: Alias targets an approved primitive absent from the primitives export
failuresByRootCause.suggestion: Re-export the Figma primitives collection including these groups. They are marked approved (✅) in Figma, so their absence is an incomplete export rather than a design decision.

failuresByRootCause.title: Alias targets a primitive group Figma marks deprecated (❌)
failuresByRootCause.suggestion: A design decision, not an export problem. In Figma either repoint these semantic tokens at the approved equivalent — e.g. replace green❌ with Green ✅ — or restore the group as approved if it is still in use.

failuresByRootCause.title: Alias resolves to another semantic token that is itself unresolved
failuresByRootCause.suggestion: Nothing to fix here — the failure is upstream. These recover automatically once the root cause they depend on is resolved, so fix the other causes first and re-generate.
